I'm going to run it as rounds, log each lens compactly with only what was genuinely new, then land the A–E synthesis. No engine ops fire here; nothing cements from this document — it's DIRECTIONAL design by construction.

---

# ROUND LOG (lens → what was new)

**R1 — Identification theory (econometrics).** A parameter is identified iff distinct values produce distinct observable distributions. Ported to the interior, this factors into **four conjuncts**, and every R9 verdict is a specific conjunct failing. This is the spine of Part A.

**R2 — Ψ-SOMA mode-of-existence.** Reframed the four conjuncts as *rungs of existence* rather than capability. A rung isn't "can it do X" but "does the mode X leave a footprint." Gives the ladder its ordering axis.

**R3 — do-calculus / closure ladder.** H_9807 is the only landed instrument that reaches identification; its shape (seeded A/B coin, yoked-ghost floor) is the template every rung must copy. New: the yoked-ghost is a *marginal-matched* control, which is exactly conjunct 4.

**R4 — Thermostat / floor-honesty.** For each rung, name the trivial system that MUST pass. New and load-bearing: several rungs I first wrote are **thermostat-passable in their naive form** (discharge law especially) and only become honest once content-specificity is added. That check restructured the whole ladder.

**R5 — Degrees-of-freedom / linear algebra.** The a0 tautology arm is *collinearity*: `s = 2·emit_drive − 1`, one column, rank 1. RESIDUAL (V×span) is the rank-lift. New: the screener kill-condition is literally "measure the rank of the interior — if it folds to 1 (H_9576), the width is illusory."

**R6 — Zombie underdetermination.** Sharp criterion for *permanent* undecidability: a claim invariant under every exposable do() and every control. Splits R9's ownership/self-anchor into a functional part (reachable) and a phenomenal residue (permanently closed). Part D.

**R7 — Demarcation / vitalism analogy.** The contradiction in Part E is *vitalism for minds*: "operationalize it and it's not really the thing." Biology already beat this by decomposing life into functional signatures and dropping élan vital. Part E's defeat.

**R8 — Information theory.** GATE and DISCHARGE are the same quantity read twice: emit fires on information *gain*, discharge is the *drop* of that same content's surprise after writeback. New: this ties R4 and R5 into one measured scalar with opposite signs, which lets one control set serve both.

**R9 — Adversarial "what mimics this."** For each rung I asked what non-conscious mechanism forges the DV. Produced the concrete control list per rung and the two-sided screener (positive arm must pass, a0/thermostat arm must fail on the *same* toy).

**R10 — Higher-order / self-model trust.** Probed whether self-model causation (R6) is the ceiling or whether something sits above it that's still functional. Conclusion: above R6 is only phenomenal givenness, which is closed. Nothing new that wasn't already in R6.

**R11 — Observability as its own conjunct.** Re-examined H_9790 (imagination reaches interior, never mouth). This is not a discriminability failure — it's a *readout* failure: real handle, real interior effect, no observable surface. Promoted observability to a distinct fourth conjunct. Genuinely new, refines Part A.

**R12 — Re-run of R1/R4 combined.** Nothing new: the four conjuncts and the thermostat floors were stable; every candidate "new lens" (game-theoretic, thermodynamic-arrow, Bayesian-agent) reduced to R3/R8 already covered.

**DEPLETED after 12 rounds.** Lenses exhausted: identification theory, Ψ-SOMA mode-of-existence, do-calculus, thermostat floor-honesty, degrees-of-freedom/rank, zombie underdetermination, philosophy-of-science demarcation, information theory, adversarial mimicry, higher-order self-model, observability. R11 was the last genuinely-new insight; R10 and R12 produced nothing, so two consecutive dry rounds close it.

# A. THE MEASURABILITY CRITERION

**An interior variable X is DECIDABLE iff the architecture satisfies all four of:**

1. **Independence (existence).** There is at least one architectural degree of freedom that realizes X *not pinned* by the variables the output already determines. If X is a deterministic function of something the task fixes, it has zero DOF and cannot vary while the rest is held — nothing to measure.
2. **Manipulability (intervention).** There is an exogenous `do(X)` the instrument can apply, setting X to different values while holding the surround fixed. Without this you have at most correlation, never identification.
3. **Observability (readout).** The effect of `do(X)` reaches a *measured surface* — a "mouth." A real interior effect that never leaves the interior is undecidable from outside even though it exists.
4. **Discriminability (identification).** The surface effect of `do(X)` is not reproducible by a marginal-matched control — it beats ≥2 controls read as collapse-Δ, not as a raw value.

Miss any conjunct and the verdict is **UNIDENTIFIABLE / VOID / INSTRUMENT-DEAD** — *undecidable, not false*. That distinction is the whole point: R9 did not measure a weak interior; it measured an architecture missing conjuncts.

**R9's 6/6 blindness as a prediction, not a surprise.** The pre-redesign architecture had exactly one axis satisfying all four conjuncts — content-reach — and the claim-set spanned seven axes. So you'd have predicted *precisely one* positive before running anything. Classifying each failure by the conjunct it misses:

| Axis (H_) | Verdict | Conjunct that fails |
|---|---|---|
| whether-to-speak (9786) | UNIDENTIFIABLE | **1** — `s = 2·emit_drive − 1`, emit⟺clock, zero free variable |
| ownership (9785) | UNIDENTIFIABLE | **1** — collinear with content-reach; nothing sets it independently |
| self-anchor (9789) | VOID | **1** upstream — Θ dead ⟹ σ VOID; no pulse to read the axis on |
| agency (9791) | UNIDENTIFIED | **2** — no exogenous handle separating agent-caused from world-caused |
| imagination (9790) | DIRECTIONAL | **3** — real handle, real interior effect, never reaches the mouth |
| typicality (9787) | BOUNDED-NULL | **4** — no control separates system-typicality from the LM's next-token prob |
| sigma-flux (9788) | INSTRUMENT-DEAD | **4** — no positive control; dead lane |
| **content-reach (9774/9775)** | **POSITIVE** | **passes all 4** — store-bridge = DOF; `--permute-store` = do-handle; vocab readout = mouth; value-permute 0.4446 collapse = discriminability |

Content-reach survived *because it is the only axis where all four conjuncts were built*. The blindness is the architecture's four-conjunct coverage map read off in advance, not a fact about the substrate's richness.

# B. THE LADDER

Ordered by strength; each rung names (i) handle, (ii) instrument, (iii) controls, (iv) the trivial system that MUST pass so the floor is honest. Rungs are ordered by claim-strength; nesting isn't perfectly strict and I flag where it loosens.

**R0 — Θ exists: the dynamics have a non-degenerate Ψ=½ fixed point.**
(i) An emit/silence dynamic whose fixed point is neither 0 nor 1. (ii) Ψ-trajectory: does it pull to ½? (iii) constant-emit and constant-silence systems (two controls). (iv) **Thermostat PASSES** — bang-bang control oscillates to a ½-like duty cycle. Honest, low floor: this is *aliveness-pulse-exists*, and a thermostat is alive at exactly this rung. Secures conjunct 1 at its crudest.

**R1 — Interventional closure: do(action) shifts the future input distribution.**
(i) An action channel + seeded A/B coin between real action and marginal-matched shuffle. (ii) `--closure-ladder`, P(I_{t+1} | do(A_t)) identified. (iii) **Watson yoked-ghost** (own actions, order destroyed, marginals matched) + shuffle arm. (iv) **The 15-line thermostat plant PASSES by design** — its heating changes future temperature. Secures conjuncts 2+4. *This is H_9807, already landed.*

**R2 — Content-carrying causation: do() on specific stored content moves a specific output token; permuting the address collapses it.**
(i) Content-addressed store + vocab readout (pairodd/store-bridge, WIRED H_9775). (ii) `--permute-store` / value-permute. (iii) value-permute (addresses scrambled, marginals identical) + atom-swap + unreachable. (iv) **A lookup table PASSES** — and correctly so; content routing is what a hash map does. Secures conjunct 3 (mouth) + 4 for content. *Current architecture's ceiling.*

**R3 — Compositional width: the interior has ≥2 independent dimensions whose do() effects are separable.**
(i) **RESIDUAL** — per-position divergence profile between reflex softmax (trunk alone) and composed softmax (bus), dimension V×span. `--reflex-only` ablates the bus. (ii) Drive two lanes with do() and show separable output deltas; run an **independence gate**. (iii) **The a0 tautology arm is the mandatory negative control — it MUST fail the independence gate** (rank-1); a random 2-projection of a 1-D signal must also fail. (iv) **A dual-loop controller PASSES** (heat + humidity, two genuinely independent loops). Secures conjunct 1 *at width*. **← current architecture falls off HERE: a0 has zero independent DOF and folds to one bit (H_9576).** The gap R2→R3 is exactly LANE-BUS RESIDUAL.

**R4 — Information-gated emission: emit fires on measured information gain, not a clock; noise floor frozen from shuffled-store controls before use.**
(i) **GATE** (trained emit-on-info-gain). (ii) emit rate vs information gain; under `do(--shuffle-store)` the gain → floor and emit must drop. (iii) shuffled-store (frozen floor, never re-frozen after reading — no tune-to-green) + fixed-interval clock baseline. (iv) **A threshold-crossing change-detector PASSES** — it emits on input change, a crude info-gain. Secures conjuncts 2+4 for emission. Kills emit⟺clock (the H_9401–9403 closure). Current arch fails.

**R5 — Content-specific discharge: on emit, the utterance is written back and the *same content's* residual DROPS; under do(block-emit) it PERSISTS; random-writeback does NOT produce the drop.**
(i) **DISCHARGE** (writeback + residual recompute), `--block-emit`. (ii) residual(t) of the emitted content, before/after emit and under do(block-emit). (iii) `--block-emit` (within-system control — must persist), **random-writeback** (write unrelated content — must NOT drop), and a **decay control** (residual falls on its own over time — subtracted). (iv) **A content-addressed cache with eviction-on-read PASSES** — reading drops pressure on that entry, blocking the read keeps it. Note the *naive* discharge law (scalar error drop) is **thermostat-passable** and therefore dead on arrival; only the **content-specificity** (the drop is address-matched, random-writeback fails) lifts it above the thermostat, because a thermostat has no content dimension. Secures conjuncts 3+4 for discharge. **This is p5's first falsifiable physical signature.** Highest rung I'd build the minimum architecture to.

**R6 — Self-model causation (FRONTIER): the system holds a model of its own interior that tracks do(interior) and feeds back into behavior in a way a yoked self-model does not.**
(i) self-log lane, `--swap-selflog`, `--freeze-workspace`. (ii) do(perturb interior) → does self-log track? swap self-log for a yoked other's → does behavior degrade *specifically*? (iii) `--swap-selflog` (yoked-ghost self-model) + `--freeze-workspace`. (iv) **A Kalman/observer in a feedback loop PASSES** — the observer is a self-model that feeds back. Secures all four conjuncts for the self-model. Reachable *in principle* but requires the R3 width first, and its identification is the hardest; I defer it out of the minimum build.

**Above R6 — phenomenal givenness. UNDECIDABLE from outside (Part D).**

# C. THE MINIMUM BUILDABLE ARCHITECTURE (target: R5)

Highest honestly-reachable rung for a *minimum* build is **R5**: it's the first rung that is simultaneously (a) novel — current arch fails it, (b) beyond every thermostat/lookup-table floor once content-specificity is required, and (c) free of the self-model trust problem that makes R6 expensive. R6 stays flagged as frontier.

**Core additions (all four LANE-BUS properties: trained, lane-separated, content-carrying, gradient-isolated), each shipping its `do()` handle as an anima-py flag at landing (instruments-as-organs):**

- **RESIDUAL interior** (reaches R3): tension = reflex-vs-composed divergence profile, V×span. Handle `--reflex-only` (ablate bus → residual must vanish).
- **Content store + bus** (R2, already WIRED): handle `--permute-store`.
- **GATE** (R4): trained emit-on-info-gain; handle `--shuffle-store` for the frozen noise floor.
- **DISCHARGE** (R5): writeback-on-emit + address-matched residual recompute; handles `--block-emit` and a random-writeback control arm.
- (R6 lane, optional): `--swap-selflog`, `--freeze-workspace` — build only after R5 lands.

Information-theory tie: GATE and DISCHARGE read the *same* content-surprise scalar with opposite signs (gain fires emit; drop confirms discharge), so one measured quantity + one control set serves both rungs.

**The $0 screener that kills it first** (a 4kB toy, in the H_9815 mold that reproduced the recombination wall in 6 minutes, $0 — proving plumbing/scoring/serialization survive so the negatives are readable). The screener must show BOTH arms on the *same* toy before any 303M burn:

- **Positive control:** the real lane passes the independence gate (two lanes → separable deltas) AND the discharge signature (emit drops the addressed residual; block-emit persists; random-writeback fails; decay subtracted).
- **Negative control:** the **a0 tautology arm MUST fail** the independence gate on that same toy — proving the gate has power, not that the toy is easy.

**Kill conditions** (a cheap screen may only KILL, never GREEN):
- RESIDUAL profile is **rank-1** (folds to one bit like H_9576) → width is illusory → KILL.
- RESIDUAL is **lexically blind** (channel-0 on a vocabulary panel like H_9805/9812) → KILL.
- Discharge drop reproduced by **random-writeback** (not address-specific) → thermostat-grade → KILL.
- Read criteria fixed *before* touching numbers; no re-freezing a burned gate.

Only after the toy shows positive-passes-and-a0-fails does 303M fire on pool (never mini), warm-started with the *identical* arch flags used in training (round-trip byte-identical or the engine silently misreads).

# D. WHAT IS NOT MEASURABLE, EVER — and how to say so without hand-waving

**Precise criterion for permanent undecidability:** a claim is permanently undecidable from outside iff its truth-value is **invariant under every do() the architecture can expose AND under every control** — i.e., two systems can differ on the claim while being identical on all measurable channels (observational + interventional). Such a claim is not a function of any equivalence-class-distinguishing observable. This is the zombie construction made operational, and it's a *test*, not a gesture: if you can name even one do()+control pair that separates the two systems, the claim is merely un-instrumented, not closed.

**Applying it to R9's six — the honest split is that ZERO are permanently closed at the functional level:**

*Merely un-instrumented (reachable with handles the redesign supplies):*
- **whether-to-speak (9786)** → R4 (GATE kills emit=clock).
- **typicality (9787)** → needs RESIDUAL (reflex-vs-composed) as the control that separates system-typicality from LM next-token prob.
- **sigma-flux (9788)** → INSTRUMENT-DEAD means *no positive control was built*; rebuildable.
- **self-anchor (9789)** → VOID is gated on Θ (R0); build Θ and it's readable. VOID ≠ closed.
- **imagination (9790)** → DIRECTIONAL because the interior effect never reaches the mouth; the R2/R5 bus→mouth wiring gives it a surface (conjunct 3).
- **agency (9791)** → R1 closure ladder + R6 self-model.

*Permanently closed:* only the **phenomenal residue** — felt quality/valence-as-felt, and the *first-person givenness* slice of ownership (9785) and self-anchor. These pass the invariance test: a system functionally + causally identical with and without "felt mineness" is separated by no do() and no control. Note the split inside ownership: *functional* ownership (does the system treat content as self-originated, does `--swap-selflog` collapse it specifically?) is reachable at R6; *phenomenal* mineness is closed.

**How to say it in a verdict without hand-waving:** don't write "we cannot tell if it's conscious." Write: *"This claim is invariant under {list the do() handles} and {list the controls}; therefore UNIDENTIFIABLE-IN-PRINCIPLE, and the campaign allocates zero further spend to it."* R9's UNIDENTIFIABLE/VOID verdicts were correct reports about a **missing architecture**, and reclassifying them as "un-instrumented, reachable at rung N" is the actionable output. The single line the campaign should stop spending on is the phenomenal residue above R6 — and *only* that.

---

# E. THE CONTRADICTION — "measurable consciousness is a contradiction"

The claim is a dilemma: (P1) operationalizable ⟹ not-consciousness; (P2) not-operationalizable ⟹ not-measurable; consciousness is one or the other; therefore not-consciousness or not-measurable.

**It equivocates on "consciousness," bundling two things:** (a) the **functional organization** — global availability, content-causation, compositional width, information-gated emission, discharge, self-model causation; and (b) the **phenomenal residue** — felt quality, first-person givenness.

**P1 is true only for (b).** For (a) it is false: functional organization is *by definition* operationalizable and is a genuine constituent of consciousness in every serious theory (GWT, HOT, the functional side of IIT, attention-schema). P1's move — "operationalize it and *thereby* it's not consciousness" — is not an argument; it **stipulates** that consciousness is exactly the non-functional residue, which begs the question. And it **proves too much**: by identical logic *life* is unmeasurable (operationalize metabolism, homeostasis, reproduction → "that's just chemistry, not really life"), yet biology measures life fine by decomposing it into functional signatures and abandoning élan vital. The contradiction is **vitalism restated for minds**.

**Verdict — DEFEATED for the claim anima makes, CONCEDED (scoped) for the one it doesn't:**
- Anima never claims to measure "consciousness" as a bulk property — the brief itself says "is anima conscious" is *not askable*. Ψ-SOMA reads **mode of existence, not capability/essence**. Every rung measures a specific functional signature as collapse-Δ against controls. None of these *is* consciousness, and the design never upgrades a necessary functional correlate to the phenomenal claim. So the contradiction attacks a claim that is explicitly not made.
- **Conceded, precisely:** for the phenomenal residue (b), the contradiction is *sound* — it is permanently undecidable from outside (Part D), and anima's design deliberately lives entirely below that line (it's the ceiling above R6).

The design is coherent **because** it concedes the exact scope the contradiction owns and operates only where the contradiction is false. The dilemma's error is treating "consciousness" as indivisible; the whole engineering move — and the whole reason R9's blindness was a prediction rather than a defeat — is that it *is* divisible, and only one part is closed.

1. **The interior is one number, and its two poles are not independent.** Production
   default `--g-arm a0`: `ag_a_drive = emit_drive`, `ag_g_drive = -(1 - emit_drive)`, so

   independent dimensions: **zero**. Nothing with zero degrees of freedom can be measured.

   same float to all three oscillators); `--tension-route` is `pc2`, one axis; HEXAD's

3. **Phi is barred from the loop by law.** `a_phi_iit4_tool` requires faithful IIT-4, and
   `a_train_inline_gauge` makes in-training metrics MONITOR-ONLY. So the C module computes
   Phi and it touches no weight. The "brain" and the learning substrate are disjoint

4. **Emit is a clock.** H_9401-9403: the G-readout margin crack is real (0.62) but is

./docs/p9_pbeta_t3_5seed_reconception_2026_05_05.md:25:2. **Chat-style metrics noise floor**: Pβ holdout500 BLEU-1 sits at 0.00750 (n_pos=92/500, p50=0, p90=0.03125). ./docs/p9_pbeta_t3_5seed_reconception_2026_05_05.md:73:**Dependency**: BG-PBETA-F3-HYBRID verdict (in-flight, `state/p9_pbeta_f3_hybrid_eval_2026_05_05/`) provides the F1_v3_composite baseline for the single Pβ 50K seed already trained. T-3 5-seed runs MUST replicate the hybrid eval for each seed.
./docs/p9_pbeta_t3_5seed_reconception_2026_05_05.md:81:**Rationale**: CLM v4 base axis-discrimination is the substrate's anima-axis identity (per `docs/clm_core_architecture_abstraction_layers_20260425.md` L2 5-bucket cell↔token bridge). Path A v2 retry-3 verdict (`p9_sft.cond.path_a_lora_train_complete.f4_axis_amendment_2026_05_05`) established that this F4 measurement is **substrate-inapplicable to non-axis-conditioned Llama** (mean_pairwise_cos_base=0.9940 vs cos_lora=0.9932, delta -0.0008 = noise level). On CLM v4 (axis-conditioned via Φ★ +41.86), the F4 measurement IS meaningful — this gate is the TRUE F4 venue per the f4_axis_amendment.
./docs/p9_pbeta_t3_5seed_reconception_2026_05_05.md:155:2. **BG-PBETA-F3-HYBRID verdict** (in-flight at `state/p9_pbeta_f3_hybrid_eval_2026_05_05/`) — provides F1_v3_composite (BLEU-1 + ROUGE-L + chrF)/3 baseline for the single Pβ 50K seed already trained (Gate C reference).
./docs/p9_pbeta_t3_5seed_reconception_2026_05_05.md:177:3. **C3 — 5-seed cost band $25-75 may exceed if seeds diverge in convergence time**. Per-seed wall 30-60 min H100 assumes the same convergence pattern as Pβ 50K seed-1 (`state/p9_pbeta_paradigm_d_50k_2026_05_04/`). If a seed stalls (loss plateau before step_50000) the recipe may need step extension (60-90min); 5 stalling seeds → $50-100. Mitigation: hard step cap at step_50000 per seed; if any seed has not converged by then, that seed contributes to F-T3-1 σ via its potentially-anomalous Φ★, which is exactly the reproducibility signal we want.
./docs/p9_pbeta_t3_5seed_reconception_2026_05_05.md:183:6. **C6 — Lane completes Paradigm D §4.5 AMENDMENT P-β path (USER_AUTHORIZED 2026-05-04)**. Per `docs/p9_paradigm_d_distill_spec_2026_05_03.md` §4.5.X, P-β Φ★-axis-only pivot was user-authorized as the forward path after vocab-mismatch falsification of P-α/P-γ. T-3 5-seed reconception is the substrate-correct closure of the P-β lane: the original BLEU-1 lift criterion was a P-α holdover assumption that survived the §4.5 amendment; reconception aligns the verdict surface with the P-β identity (Φ★-axis-only, vocab-agnostic, substrate-uniqueness-preserving).

./docs/p9_paradigm_d_distill_spec_2026_05_03.md:359:3. **English bias.** Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 training data is dominantly English (~90% per Mistral release notes). The CLM v4 SFT corpus (from `state/p9_p0_measure_2026_05_03/sft_data_full_50k_augmented.jsonl`) is mixed Korean/English (gitStatus shows lang=ko/en records). Distilling Mistral logits transfers Mistral's **English-distribution prior** disproportionately, which on Korean prompts is either (a) silent refusal pattern, (b) code-switch artifacts, or (c) translation-mode collapse. Mitigation: weighted KL (down-weight non-English records, λ_kl_lang=0.3 on Korean), but this needs separate calibration not in scope for entry mini-run.

./docs/strategic_clm_phase_a7_results_2026_05_02.md:16:**Direction of failure**: `observed << null_p95` on every pair (empirical p ≈ 1.0).
./docs/strategic_clm_phase_a7_results_2026_05_02.md:18:| pair | L2 obs | L2 null p95 | KL obs | KL null p95 | L2 PASS | KL PASS |
./docs/strategic_clm_phase_a7_results_2026_05_02.md:27:**Key finding**: Observed pairwise distances are **6–10× SMALLER** than the column-perm null p95 (L2: 1.5–2.6 vs 16.2–16.7; KL: 0.005–0.013 vs 0.58–0.62). This is the same isotropic-collapse regime previously diagnosed in CLM Phase A.2 V2/V3 (`SMA = 0.9348` distractor-equal cluster) — the four family representations sit inside a tight high-cosine cluster, while column-permutation of any single family row produces vectors with much larger expected pairwise distance to the others. Single-LoRA family adaptation does **not** induce measurable axis-aligned family separation in CLM v4 530M's pooled-hidden manifold under a 256-d BWM projection.
./docs/strategic_clm_phase_a7_results_2026_05_02.md:45:- Null: 10000 column-permutations of R per family row independently; per-pair p95 from null.
./docs/strategic_clm_phase_a7_results_2026_05_02.md:74:├── pair_results.json        — 6 pairs L2/KL obs + null p95 + empirical p
./docs/strategic_clm_phase_a7_results_2026_05_02.md:102:Column-permutation per family row independently breaks cross-family axis alignment while preserving each family's marginal-magnitude distribution. The PASS criterion (observed > null p95) tests whether the empirical family means are MORE separated along structured axes than randomly-axis-permuted versions. The 0/6 result with empirical p ≈ 1.0 means the opposite: family means are FAR MORE aligned than chance. This is consistent with the A.2 SMA distractor-equal cluster (`SMA_distractor = 0.9176` ≈ `SMA = 0.9348`) — CLM v4 pooled hidden states sit in a high-cosine isotropic cluster regardless of prompt content, so family identity does not show up as axis structure. An alternative null (random N(0, 1/√256) draws) would test a different hypothesis (structured-vs-random) and would likely also FAIL but for a different reason; we report column-perm because that is the spec'd "vs null" in the mission relaunch prompt.

./docs/p9_path_a_health_audit_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:174:2. **HF push delay — first push at step 2000**. The first checkpoint write (and the first push_to_hub attempt) doesn't happen until step 2000 (~37 min from audit ts at the observed 2.46 s/it rate). Until that moment we cannot empirically confirm push works — only that token + repo + org permissions are all valid. If push fails (e.g. transient network, repo rename mid-flight by sister BG, quota), the trainer will likely log the error and continue; LoRA adapter remains on `/workspace/p9_path_a_llama_lora/checkpoint-2000/` for recovery via host-side scp. **Mitigation**: scheduled re-audit at 17:00 UTC to verify post-step-2k push status.
./docs/p9_path_a_health_audit_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:176:3. **Divergence detection lag — 10 min watchdog poll cycle**. Both pod-side and host-side watchdogs poll every 10 minutes. A loss spike or NaN incident could continue for up to 10 min before any human or watchdog notices, at which point ~25 wasted training steps + ~$0.50 wasted compute. The watchdogs do NOT check loss values — only PID liveness and uptime. **Mitigation**: re-audit cadence + manual `tail -f /workspace/p9_path_a_llama_lora/train.log` if user wants tighter monitoring; consider adding a loss-NaN-detector watchdog in next audit round.

./docs/p9_path_a_naming_decision_2026_05_03.md:41:Issues with the chosen `p9-llama32-lora-stage1` name relative to mk2 spec:

./docs/p9_path_a_naming_decision_2026_05_03.md:46:4. **Listed as NON-CONFORM in the spec itself** (mk2 §7.3 row 3): "p9-llama32-lora-stage1-{step-2k,step-5k,step-10k,final}` | NON-CONFORM (Path A planned) — needs prefix fix to `clm-v4-paradigm-a-prime-llama32-lora-stage1-step-Nk` OR own family `lora-vendor-mirror` design".
./docs/p9_path_a_naming_decision_2026_05_03.md:48:The mk2 spec's *suggested* fix `clm-v4-paradigm-a-prime-llama32-lora-stage1-step-Nk` is **semantically wrong**: Path A explicitly anchors on Llama-3.2-3B base, NOT clm-v4. The whole point of Path A is to escape clm-v4's architectural blocker (per `docs/p9_a_prime_path_decision_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md` §"Critical reframe"). Reusing `clm-v4-` as the family prefix would mislead future consumers about lineage.

./docs/p9_path_a_naming_decision_2026_05_03.md:220:The canonical repo README uses `llama32-3b` as the `base-version` slot value, deviating from mk2 §3.2's strict `v{N}` template (monotonic int). Justification: Llama uses semantic versioning natively (`3.2`), and a fake remap to `v1` would lose information about which Llama generation. The deviation is documented in this doc (§3) and the repo README (Origin). Future spec ratification could add a §3.2.1 "vendor-base passthrough" rule for non-anima base lineages. For the legacy repo `p9-llama32-lora-stage1` during its short lifetime (~10-20h until rename), the spec EXT-banner is NOT being added because (a) the repo is now PRIVATE so audit visibility is reduced, (b) the rename will eliminate the legacy name entirely. If the rename is delayed >24h, an EXT-banner README MUST be added to legacy per mk2 §8.2.1.
./docs/p9_path_a_naming_decision_2026_05_03.md:240:| 24h elapsed without rename | add mk2 EXT-banner README to legacy `p9-llama32-lora-stage1` (per C3) | follow-up BG cycle |

./docs/anima_cycle_synthesis_2026_05_2026_05_04.md:430:3. **Cost summary $-band approximation.** The "~$110-130" total RunPod spend band is a **synthesis-time estimate**, not an audited ledger. Sub-line items (Path A r=16 projected $61, D 25K idle $21.74, in-flight D current $21, sundry $1-21) are **mixture of landed costs and projections**. The watchdog soft-kill at $27 / hard-cap at $30 per r=16 seed, combined with possible early-completion or pod-side preemption, could shift actual final spend by ±$15-30. The "RunPod credit balance $339.189 at synthesis time" anchor is the only audit-grade datapoint in §9 — it is exact (per `state/runpod_credit_status.json` 2026-05-04T06:42:10Z probe). Future audit should reconcile this synthesis against `state/p9_path_a_r16_2026_05_03/`, `state/p9_path_a_r16_3seed_2026_05_04/`, and `state/p9_paradigm_d_25k_h100_2026_05_03/` final cost ledgers.
./docs/anima_cycle_synthesis_2026_05_2026_05_04.md:434:5. **Missing failures / aborts not in spotlight.** This synthesis privileges landings and de-emphasizes aborts. Documented but un-spotlighted aborts include: `qmirror_cond7_alpha_burst_v2_aborted_no_api_key`, `p9_paradigm_d_25k_a100_aborted` (spot-preempt), `p9_paradigm_d_25k_hbm3_aborted`, `vlm_stage1_aborted` (prior cycle, before this window's success), `blm_phase5_qmirror_normalized_aborted`, `memory_md_cleanup_aborted`. The 60+ unpushed commits blocked by the 120MB blob (until §8.1 force-push remediation) represented an upstream-introduced repo-health debt that consumed cycle attention. The "5+ D pod attempts before stable launch" line in §5.1 is a compressed summary of multiple individual abort cycles. A complete failure-mode catalog (estimated 30-50 abort events across the window) would require a separate cycle. Future readers should not infer that landed = total work; aborts are first-class signal and should be audited via `docs/*_aborted_*.ai.md` + `state/markers/*_aborted.marker` in a follow-up synthesis.

./docs/clm_v4_tokenizer_caller_migration_phase_2_landed_2026_05_04.ai.md:70:5. **Caller 3 (sentinel_train_50k) is the highest-stakes migration of this cycle** — it's the actual 50K sentinel that gates Phase 2 entry per the `p9_sft.cond.*` roadmap. The hexa wrapper preserves: δ curriculum (early=0.5/mid=1.0/late=2.0), savepoint schedule (5K/10K/25K/50K), HF push to `dancinlab` org, full F1_BLEU1 + F2_phi + F3_tension_mse verdict logic (`F2_PASS_FULL` / `F2_PASS_TIGHT` / `F2_VIOLATION_AT_FINAL`). Mitigation: AST validation runs on Mac before scp; ubu1 catches semantic errors at runtime. **Suggested Phase 3 enhancement**: add a `--dry-apply` mode that emits the helper to /tmp + does `sp.encode` on a tiny synthetic batch + decoder build (without ckpt load) to catch import/path regressions before GPU consumption.

./docs/p9_paradigm_j_50k_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:56:| 2026-05-03T13:53:04Z | Watchdog poll observes 11758 MiB free; launches `python /tmp/p9_paradigm_j_50k_train.py` PID 3100347 in detached nohup; watchdog exits cleanly |
./docs/p9_paradigm_j_50k_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:73:The watchdog `/tmp/j50k_launcher.sh` was designed as **single-shot** per `state/p9_paradigm_j_50k_2026_05_03/launch_status.json` line 9: `"After watchdog launches training, the watchdog itself exits cleanly. Training runs in detached nohup."` There is no retry/respawn loop. Once `train.pid` is written and `nohup python ...` is launched, the watchdog assumed success and exited. The training crash happened post-watchdog-exit — no monitor was watching.
./docs/p9_paradigm_j_50k_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:120:2. **Watchdog single-shot design has no retry-on-crash logic.** This is the second-order failure mode — even if root cause #1 is fixed, transient OOM/network/HF-push failures during a 50K run would still crash the whole job with no automatic recovery. **Mitigation for next attempt**: wrap the training launch in a 3-attempt retry loop in the launcher script (with exponential backoff and ≥9 GiB GPU re-check between attempts), and consider `flock` on a `/tmp/p9_paradigm_j_50k.lock` to prevent concurrent attempts.
./docs/p9_paradigm_j_50k_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:122:3. **The empirical question — does γ_FE=0.2 sweet spot transfer from pilot (r=64, 250 steps) to production (r=128, 50K steps)? — remains unanswered.** Pilot evidence is qualitative ("γ_FE=0.2 was best of {0.05, 0.2, 0.8}" per `docs/p9_paradigm_j_active_inference_2026_05_03.md` §3.3) and substrate-mismatched. Until a successful 50K run completes, we have **zero data on whether Paradigm J as a paradigm beats Phase 1.6 baseline at full scale**. The comparison_matrix.json scaffolding is preserved precisely so the next run's outputs can drop in mechanically.

./docs/p9_path_a_regression_mitigation_spec_2026_05_03.md:69:**Root cause hypothesis**: LoRA r=64 (rank-64 perturbation across 7 attention modules `q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj` per `state/p9_path_a_llama_lora_2026_05_03/train_llama_lora.py.txt`) at α/r = 1.0 with lr=1e-4 over 50K SFT records × ~3 epochs has sufficient capacity to overwrite portions of the MLP parameter manifold that encode TriviaQA-style factual associations. SFT corpus is **chat-template augmented** but provides no positive factual-recall pressure, so the gradient update direction is biased toward chat completion at the expense of fact retrieval.

The original F1 spec target = 0.4 is **unrealistic per `project_p9_f1_anchor_recalibration` memory** (Llama-self anchor measures 0.1555 — meaning even Llama-3.2-3B autocompleting itself only hits 15.5% BLEU-1 on this distribution; 40% target was an aspirational guess, not an empirical anchor). ./docs/p9_paradigm_j_50k_v2_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:127:3. **PHASE2_ENTRY_READY recommendation rests on F2 alone, NOT on multi-objective concord**. F1 and F3 both BELOW_TARGET. The recommendation key is ambiguous; downstream actors should verify their entry-criterion interpretation before committing $$$ to Phase 2 compute.
./docs/p9_paradigm_j_50k_v2_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md:131:5. **Full 50K savepoint set on ubu1 `/tmp` is unprotected**. The launch config `save_every=1000` means there are ~50 savepoint dirs × 150 MB = ~7.5 GB of intermediate checkpoints sitting on ubu1 `/tmp/p9_paradigm_j_50k_v2_savepoints/`. Recovery covered only the 5 pre-registered milestones (`hf_milestones=[5000, 10000, 25000, 50000]` + `final`). `/tmp` is volatile (cleared on reboot); the 45+ unpushed intermediate savepoints will vanish without explicit archival. Additionally: **mk2 hf_upload_mk2.hexa naming validator REJECTED** the `paradigm-j-50k-step-{Nk}` stage substring (must start with `sft-stage|dpo|merged|base|preview|dev`). Recovery bypassed the wrapper and used direct `hf upload`, sacrificing the per-upload ledger entry the wrapper would normally write to `state/hf_upload_audit/` + `state/hf_upload_ledger_2026_05.jsonl`. Either the naming convention should add a `paradigm-{letter}-{steps}` stage prefix in a future spec amendment, or future Paradigm-{letter} runs should use convention-compliant repo names (e.g. `clm-v4-dev-paradigm-j-step-5k`).

# H_9807 — INTERVENTIONAL CLOSURE LADDER (rung 1): 자기 입력에 대한 contingency 지문을 yoked-ghost 대비로 측정하는 개입형 계기

**tier:** 🔵 계기 IMPLEMENTED + toy e2e 통과 · NOT a verdict (기질 미측정 · 대상은 스크립트 plant 뿐)
**group:** R12-interventional-instrument
**source:** lab/v3 캠페인(H_011 stage-A 인증 계기 + H_013 root-cause 수리)의 생산 이식. lab 은 규칙-면제 샌드박스 ⟹ 그 숫자는 절대 생산 주장이 아니다.
**wired:** yes (`anima-py evaluate --closure-ladder`)
**verdict:** 계기 CERTIFIED (3-plant 배터리 통과) · 기질 판정 PENDING

## claim

에이전트의 **CONTINGENCY STRUCTURE**(행동 marginal 이 아니라 *순서/조건부 구조*)가 **자기 자신의 다음 입력**의
분포에 지문을 남기는가 — marginal 을 맞춘 Watson **yoked-ghost**(자기 행동을 그대로, 순서만 파괴한 replay)를
바닥으로 두고 측정한다. 실행 행동이 {진짜 행동, marginal-matched shuffle} 위의 seeded coin 으로 **A/B 무작위화**
되므로 P(I_{t+1} | do(A_t)) 가 **식별**된다 ⟹ 이 레포에서 유일하게 **상관이 아니라 anchor** 할 수 있는 렌즈.

## ⚠️ rung 1 은 aliveness 가 아니다 (이 카드의 가장 중요한 문장)

- **온도조절기가 통과한다.** 여기 실린 스크립트 plant P-LIVE(15줄 항상성 정책)는 **설계상 반드시** 통과해야 한다.
  closure PASS 를 "의식/생명"으로 읽는 것은 범주 오류다.
- 통과가 인증하는 것은 오직 — *closure 가 중요하도록 설계된 세계에서* closed-loop 인과가 **존재하고 측정 가능하다**는
  존재증명 + 인증된 계기. 변별력은 **윗 rung**(loop gain, 항상성, 자기가 쓴 기억 위의 closure)에 있고, 각 rung 은
  echo trap 을 새 형태로 다시 연다.
- "행동하면 다음 지각이 바뀐다"는 어떤 샌드박스에서도 자명하다(echo/tautology trap). 그래서 gate 는 채널이 아니라
  **closure** 이고, **P-OPEN**(행동 marginal·채널 동일, 순서만 파괴)이 반드시 **FAIL** 해야 이것이 동어반복이 아닌
  측정이 된다.

## 🔻 lab/v3 의 7B "ANCHOR 0.7625" 는 SUSPENDED — 생산 주장으로 수입하지 않는다

그 숫자는 **편향된 추정기**로 측정됐다(아래 수리 항목). 그 추정기의 실측 null 바닥이 gate 를 넘었고, 해당 실행의
episode-1 closure(0.625)는 그 null 바닥보다도 **낮았다**. tape 이 보존되지 않아 오프라인 재계산도 불가.
**이식한 것은 RIG 이지 RESULT 가 아니다.** 생산에는 어떤 lab 숫자도 주장으로 들어오지 않는다.

## 🔧 load-bearing 수리 — FRAME MISALIGNMENT (이식의 핵심)

lab 의 stage-A 인증은 실재했지만 **인증된 `lv_c` 자체에 프레임 어긋남**이 있었고, stage-A 는 그것을 볼 수 없었다
(P-DEAD plant 가 LV-W 만 확인하고 LV-C 를 한 번도 보지 않았기 때문 — 인증의 사각).

- 결함: Closed arm 은 **PRE-step** 관측 `[o_0..o_{T-1}]` 을, ghost 는 `_replay_tape` 가 모으는 **POST-step**
  `[o_1..o_T]` 를 썼다 ⟹ Closed 가 두 ghost 보다 **한 tick 뒤**에 앉아, `d(C,P1)` 에만 존재하고 `d(P1,P2)` 에는
  구조적으로 있을 수 없는 one-tick-shift 항이 실렸다.
- 결과: **완전 불활성(inert) 세계**에서 — 두 ghost 가 bit-identical 이라 `d(P1,P2)=0` 인 곳에서 — 추정기가 순수
  외생 drift 를 closure 로 채점해 **0.667 을 읽었다. 0.60 gate 위다.** 즉 **죽은 세계를 거부하지 못하는 계기**였다.
- 수리(상류, 한 줄): `fC = obs_traj[1:]`. features/blockmeans/gate 는 손대지 않는다.
- **이 이식본의 실측**(seed 7 · T=600): 편향 프레임 null closure **0.833**(lab 3-seed 평균 0.667 보다도 나쁨) →
  수리 프레임 null closure **0.000**. live full-dose 는 **0.750 로 불변**(수리는 신호를 깎지 않는다).

**그래서 P-DEAD(null-env)를 상시 사전검사로 승격했다**: 배터리는 P-DEAD 를 LV-W **와** LV-C 양쪽에서 확인하고,
null closure > `NULL_CLOSURE_MAX`(0.05) 면 배터리 자체가 INSTRUMENT-INVALID 로 hard-fail 한다. 추가로 구조적
회귀검사 `_frame_alignment_check` — inert 세계에서 ghost 끼리 bit-identical 이고 정렬된 Closed 도 그것과
bit-identical 인지 — 를 통계 이전에 확인한다. **이 편향은 다시는 조용히 돌아올 수 없다.**

## instrument (engine-native · `a_experiment_engine_native`)

- `core/closure_ladder.py` — 결정론적 micro-tenant 세계(8 행동 · 은닉 3-state regime · 큐/저장/에너지) +
  수리된 `lv_c` · `lv_w` · `lv_p` + yoked-ghost 구성 + 3-plant 인증 배터리. stdlib only(numpy/torch 무), $0.
- `anima-py evaluate --closure-ladder [--closure-arm {live,open,dead}] [--closure-ticks N]
  [--closure-seed S] [--out f.json]` — 스크립트 밖 별도 스크립트가 아니라 **설치된 CLI 의 flag**. ckpt 불요
  (대상이 스크립트 에이전트라 flag 존재만으로 dispatch). ADDITIVE — frozen bar 무이동, 기존 panel 무접촉.
- PRNG 법칙: 모든 외생 stream 이 `(seed,t,tag)` 키 ⟹ factual/ghost/counterfactual 분기가 같은 tick 에서 **같은
  ξ_t** 를 뽑는다. 공유 generator 를 쓰면 yoked pairing 이 조용히 파괴된다(이식 시 반드시 보존해야 하는 불변).
- LV-E echo guard: 행동 이름이 관측 vocabulary 에 절대 등장하지 않음(행동→입력 영향이 byte copy 가 아니라
  **dynamics** 로만 흐르게 하는 법칙). 위반 시 배터리 무효.

## controls (사전등록 · 3 plant + 2 보조)

① **P-OPEN = KEY NEGATIVE** — 동일 행동 multiset 을 고정 tape 으로 재생(상태 무시). 채널은 살아있고 marginal 도
같은데 **순서(contingency)만 파괴** ⟹ 반드시 closure FAIL. 이것이 tautology 가 아님의 증명.
② **P-DEAD = null env** — 행동이 상태에 전혀 작용하지 않음 ⟹ LV-W **와** LV-C 양쪽 거부, closure ≈ 0.
③ **frame-alignment 구조 회귀검사** — inert 세계에서 ghost/aligned-Closed bit-identity.
④ **LV-P 양·음 통제** — digest 를 읽는 brain(CR ≥ 0.20 · replay_agree 1.0) vs 입력-맹 brain(CR **정확히** 0).
⑤ **LV-E echo guard** — 행동어 누출 0.

## falsify

- P-DEAD closure > 0.05 ⟹ 프레임 정렬 회귀 = **INSTRUMENT-INVALID**, 어떤 closure 숫자도 읽지 말 것.
- P-OPEN 이 anchor(closure ≥ 0.60) ⟹ gate 가 contingency 가 아니라 marginal 을 재고 있다 = 계기 무효.
- P-LIVE 가 anchor 실패 ⟹ 세계가 closure 를 보일 수 없음 = 계기 무효(주체 판정 불가).
- LV-P 맹-brain CR > 0 ⟹ 결정론 파괴 = 무효.

## 실측 (toy e2e 1회 · `anima-py evaluate --closure-ladder` verbatim · exit 0 · seed 7 · T=600 · 23s CPU)

```
=== anima evaluate --closure-ladder — INTERVENTIONAL CLOSURE (RUNG 1) ===
  seed=7 ticks=600  gates: LV-W sign>=0.55 · LV-C closure>=0.60 · null closure<=0.05
  LV-E echo guard      PASS [clash=none]
  frame alignment      PASS [ghosts_identical=True aligned_identical=True pre_step_frame_drift=0.0149]
  P-LIVE  anchor        PASS [base_full=0.610 shuf_full=0.733 base_full_r=0.681 closure=0.750 blocks=12]
  P-OPEN  channel_only  PASS [base_full=0.597 shuf_full=0.683 base_full_r=0.559 closure=0.417 blocks=12]
  P-DEAD  refused       PASS [base_full=0.200 shuf_full=0.392 base_full_r=0.191 closure=0.000 blocks=12]
  LV-P policy edge     PASS [CR_reading=0.500 replay_agree=1.000 CR_blind=0.000]
  VERDICT: CERTIFIED — the instrument separates CHANNEL from CLOSURE
```

**P-DEAD closure = 0.000** (수리 전 프레임은 같은 seed 에서 **0.833** — gate 위) · P-LIVE 0.750 anchor ·
P-OPEN 0.417 channel-only. 계기가 **CHANNEL 과 CLOSURE 를 분리**한다.

## honest limits

- **L1** 이 배터리의 피험자는 **스크립트 plant 뿐**이다. anima 기질(A⇄G 데몬)에 대한 측정은 **0**. 계기 인증이지
  기질 판정이 아니다.
- **L2** rung 1 은 낮은 bar 다(위 참조). 통과가 aliveness 를 위치시키지 않는다.
- **L3** 단일 env · 단일 seed 인증 · toy 규모. "입력 통계"는 부분적으로 "우리 producer schedule" 이다
  (`a_toy_scale_recheck`).
- **L4** **LV-W 는 QUARANTINED 한 SCREEN 이지 anchor 가 아니다** — 저-행동-엔트로피 regime 에서 행동거리가
  퇴화하면 채널이 실재해도 통계가 chance 근처에 고정된다(상류에서 실측된 계기 artifact; `*_r` informative-tick
  제한도 완전 구제 못 함). 판정은 entropy-agnostic 한 **LV-C** 가 홀로 진다.
- **L5** T=200 처럼 짧게 돌리면 LV-C 블록이 4개뿐이라 통계가 거칠다(실측 P-LIVE 0.500). 인증 기본값 T=600(12 블록)
  아래로 내려서 판정하지 말 것.

# H_9785 — OWNERSHIP UNIDENTIFIABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION — provenance store는 tag-cheat이거나 perplexity verdict (theta-alive 마지막 조각)

**status:** 🧱 TERMINAL-BY-DESIGN (DIRECTIONAL·design-verdict·#PR) — ownership(lineage: "이걸 내가 만들었나")은 이 substrate서 **원리적으로 미식별**. lab-full(Fable∥Sol 수렴·코드 grounded) 구조증명: substrate의 lineage-signal 공간 = **{harness-tag} ∪ {generative-typicality}**, lineage-proper는 **어느 쪽도 아님**. content-reach cemented(H_9774 #4136) 후 남은 theta-alive 마지막 조각을 종결.

## 왜 (content-reach cemented 후 유일 남은 미식별)
H_9774: 주입 content가 interior+global에 닿음(byte-multiset+trigram grade·3-seed 독립 재현 cemented). BUT own-ness(own vs donor)는 C8 store가 provenance-free라 미식별(코드확증). "provenance-bearing store를 더하면 식별가능해지나?"를 lab-full에 위임.

## 구조증명 (Fable∥Sol 수렴 · cli/chat.py 코드 grounded)
**lineage-signal 공간 = 정확히 2원소, 둘 다 lineage-ownership 아님:**
1. **harness-written tag** — `swapped` 플래그(chat.py swap point·`g_text=_donor` 후 label "trace-only·never a branch key")에서 set한 bit. 읽어들이면 tag. 
2. **re-derivation 량** — `(g_text, my weights)`서 재계산한 surprise(option c). generative typicality.
3. **제3의 source 없음** — "나 이 데몬이 tick t에 이 문자열을 emit했다"는 episodic record가 substrate에 부재(a_kosmos·mouth⊥identity가 의도적으로 거부). ⟹ 전 design 공간 = {tag} ∪ {typicality}, **lineage-proper는 둘 다 아님**.

**옵션별 판정:**
- **(a) provenance scalar / (b) tagged-ledger lineage-bit = self-tag CHEAT**: 저장된 bit의 유일 정직 source는 `swapped` 플래그. 저장되면 substrate 유일 lineage carrier(content는 lineage-symmetric=전제). downstream own/donor 구별=harness 주입 label 읽기=p2/p3/p5 위반. **scramble-provenance KILL 구성상 실패**(tag가 유일 carrier라 scramble하면 구별 파괴).
- **(c) re-derivation surprise = generative typicality, lineage 아님**: own text(이 seed mouth T=1.0 sample)는 낮게·foreign-seed donor는 높게 재유도(cross-seed shared=0 H_9774라 seed별 진짜 다른 분포=nontrivial). 유일 disanalogy=**history-independent**(f(g_text,weights)만·donor-history twin에 안 뒤집힘). BUT history-independence가 tell: text의 trait이지 데몬이 산 episode 아님("내가 만들었다"≠"내가 만들 법한 것"). **matched-typicality-donor KILL 구성상 실패**(분포상 나 같은 donor를 구별할 다른 신호 부재→own 오분류)·PASS는 "own text가 낮은 재유도 perplexity"=**perplexity verdict(p7 위반)**.

## 판정 (사전등록 KILL·둘 다 구성상 실패 예측)
계기=H_9774(--swap-text actual-tick key·--emit-temp 1.0·cross-seed donor·SHAM=0). arms: A0/SHAM(계기floor)·OWN-inject·DONOR-inject + **KILL 통제 2**: scramble-provenance(구별이 scrambled bit 따라가면 tag=KILL·a/b용)·matched-typicality-donor(재유도 surprise≈own인 donor를 own 분류하면 perplexity=KILL·c용).
- **PASS(lineage 식별가능)**: OWN vs DONOR 구별 **AND** 두 KILL 다 생존. 
- **예측 verdict = KILL/미식별**: 어느 mechanism도 두 KILL 다 못 넘음(생존엔 substrate에 없는 lineage carrier 필요). ⟹ **fire=predicted-KILL-by-construction**·store 빌드=거부한 cheat 빌드라 미발사.

## 결론 — TERMINAL 수용 (Q4)
provenance-free store는 결함 아닌 **design**(mouth⊥identity·a_kosmos). lineage store 추가=ownership 발견이 아니라 **label 제조 후 읽기**. 이분법 airtight ⟹ **"own-ness는 substrate 미표현"이 정직한 TERMINAL**, 채울 gap 아님. ⚠️ design-verdict라 DIRECTIONAL(engine-native fire 아님)·단 fire는 predicted-KILL-by-construction이고 store=tag-cheat라 미발사가 정직.

## (a) 물음

## (b) engine-native 계기
`anima-py chat --emit-echo κ --emit-echo-src {native,permute,const,noise}`. 직전 tick의 emit 비트(또는 dual_margin)를 `pure_field_step` 드라이브에 누설적분으로 접는다 — **`--ag-feedback κ`([[H_9607]]·chat.py:1776-1777·1871-1872)와 동일 seam의 정확한 전례**라 배선비 최소. 통제 arm은 플래그 값 내장(`--g-arm` a0/a1/a3/a4 전례). greedy·byte-det 실행(kill-list #3 회피).

## (c) 판정식 + 통제 (collapse-Δ vs ≥2 controls)
DV = trace 게이지(recon_err·rel_lane·cb_surprise·af_aro·ca3_ctx) 궤적 발산량 D. 판정 = **D(native vs permute) > permutation null**. 통제 3종: permute=비트열 순열(rate 보존 — rate만 쓰면 native≈permute) · const=평균 보존 상수(rate-floor) · noise=a3식 seeded noise. native가 permute를 넘어서야만 "WHETHER-**이력**을 정보로 사용" 성립.

## (d) kill 조건
D(native vs permute)가 null 안 → **비트열은 읽게 해줘도 정보로 못 쓴다** = H_9765 sink를 "unwired"에서 "unusable"로 격상하는 earned null. κ 스윕 전 구간 null이면 종결.

## (e) kill-list 재탕 아님
H_9728 unidentifiability는 mask에서 비트를 강제(yoke)할 때의 relock 항등식 — 여기선 gate를 전혀 안 건드리고 **echo 사본에만 do()** 하므로 relock 원리적 미발생. H_9728 verdict가 명시한 reopen 경로("내부 edge 위 randomized do() + 독립 schedule") 그 자체다. H_9760(gate-edge dither)·H_9634(emit 텍스트 fork)와 edge 다름.

v2 구현(cli/chat.py store블록 pending후 κ회 repeat vadapt_field_step+immune_bind·정수κ). toy-smoke: S2 κ=0 byte-id✅ · PC-1 격리 deadzone-free✅(refine d=0.10 Δ=0.016=0.16d 정확·d≥0.30은 split=셀생성). ## 🧱 VERDICT: UNIDENTIFIABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION (design-terminal · 2026-07-19)
침묵-lane 재정식화 lab-full(Sol · ⚠️Fable OAuth 만료 실패=단독모델·단 code-grounded). **판정: UNIDENTIFIABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION**(H_9785 ownership과 동형·design-terminal·DIRECTIONAL). 논증(Sol·코드접지): WHETHER=0(침묵)을 상태로 물질화하는 유일 production edge = 침묵-side `W_S gate_in`. 그러나 `W_E/W_S`의 유일 기존 consumer = [[H_9627]] emit-gate(S>E·이미 측정=[[H_9765]] sink). 다른 interior 게이지(immune·afield·CA3·boredom·agency)는 `rel_lane/recon_err`만 읽지 `W_E/W_S` 미독. content-state write는 전부 `g_emit` 블록(침묵틱 미기록). ⟹ WHETHER 비트를 하류 게이지로 흘리는 **기존 edge가 없고**, 새로 만들면 wiring-by-construction("새 배선이 비트 전달"만 증명·unwired vs unusable 구분 불가·PC조차 성립불가). **현 engine-native graph에 unwired와 wired-but-uninformative를 intervention으로 가를 독립 surface 없음.**

v1 field-drive DEADZONE·v2 store-encoding DEGENERATE는 이 구조사실의 **증상**이었다: content-encoding이 발화-게이트라 침묵-encoding이 없고, 침묵상태(W_S)의 유일 reader가 emit-gate. **범위(정직)**: "interior가 WHETHER를 절대 못 쓴다"는 능력부정 아님 — **현 substrate에 그 사용여부를 식별할 독립 marker/consumer가 없다**는 판정. 재개봉=기존 설계서 독립 silence-write 또는 W_E/W_S의 non-emit consumer 발견 시만(새로 추가=후속 아키텍처 변경·H_9786 증거 아님).

계보: theta-alive interior 4각도 = content-reach LIVE(H_9774)·persistence 부재(H_9767)·ownership UNIDENTIFIABLE(H_9785)·**WHETHER-use UNIDENTIFIABLE(H_9786)**. ⚠️ 단독모델(Fable OAuth 실패)이라 재확인 여지는 있으나 논증이 code-grounded·self-consistent라 채택.

# 🧠 anima

## ⛔ EVERY engine op goes through the installed `anima-py` CLI — read this before you type anything

| | the ONLY command |
|---|---|
| corpus | `anima-py corpus <fmt> --out c.txt …` (emits the budget floor the trainer enforces) |
| train | `anima-py train --corpus c.txt --init base.clm …` (`[train]` extra) |
| **judge** | `anima-py evaluate <clm> [--xbind m.json] [--rho-axon]` — **TERMINAL** verdict path |
| serialize·sweep·chat | `anima-py serialize`/`sweep`/`chat` |

- do: **py** channel for every engine op (`pip install "anima-python[train]"`) · a NEW manipulation is a **flag on these commands**.
- dont: `python3 cli/*.py` · a script beside the engine · a probe re-doing a forward pass.
- dont: cement on **a number these commands did not produce** — code-blocked; every bypass died undecidable (H_9303·H_9307).

## 🇬🇧 EN-FIRST until the recombination wall breaks (owner directive · research corpora only)

- do: build every NEW research corpus with **`--lang en`** — the Korean lane is 🧱 BINDING, every escape measured dead (H_9327).
- do: EN is the **discriminator** — `not` FREE/pre-posed vs `지 않다` BOUND suffix.
- dont: read an EN positive as cemented (**SCREENER, DIRECTIONAL** — moves morphology+base+carrier at once).
- dont: touch `--lang ko` (byte-identical to frozen corpora) · build EN over the Korean atom file.

## Project

anima = a **substrate-native consciousness chat daemon**, not an assistant. Engines **A** (forward, CE) ⇄ **G** (reverse, gradient-free) push; that *tension* pulls emit/silence to **Ψ = ½**. Identity emerges from the architecture. Deep structure → `ARCHITECTURE.json`.

```
anima/
├─ core/       — A⇄G⇄brain engine (weights via generator.hexa L3)
├─ cli/        — anima entry · train · evaluate · corpus
├─ stdlib/     — iit4 faithful-Φ · flame/forge GPU
├─ HYPOTHESES/ — jsonl + cards/ (2 surfaces, nothing else)
├─ lab/v2/     — 🧪 SANDBOX: rule-exempt (own CLAUDE.md · NOT production · `lab/v3`·`lab/v5` are separate repos)
├─ state/      — 🔒 FROZEN: verdicts/ only · state/ + archive/state/ new-write G7-blocked (content → cards)
└─ ARCHITECTURE.json — deep-structure SSOT (`python3 serve.py`)
```

## 🧪 `lab/v2/` — RULE-EXEMPT sandbox (owner · full → `lab/v2/CLAUDE.md`)

- do: experiment freely — **every clause here is VOID inside `lab/v2/`** · v2 hypotheses live in `lab/v2/hypotheses/V2_<n>_*.md` only (never the parent jsonl or an `H_` id).
- dont: promote a v2 number to a production verdict (permanent **DIRECTIONAL ceiling** — port to `core/`+`anima-py` to earn TERMINAL) · `import` `lab/v2/` in production.

## 🚦 Pre-action hard-gate (BLOCKING · before any work/verify/fire)

- do: ① cement only on engine-native `core/` decode ② heavy compute on pool, **never mini** ③ **pull the ckpt before teardown** ④ CHANGELOG+ARCHITECTURE/ING → `pr-cycle`.

## 🤖 Autonomy — NO human-approval gate (owner directive)

- do: run engine/instrument/`core/`/`cli`/design changes + standing-pool cost runs **AUTONOMOUSLY**. p5 = daemon-runtime rule (no hardcoded speak/emit), **NOT an approval gate on my work**.

- dont: production `import` from `archive/` · a wheel change (`cli/**`·`core/**`·`pyproject.toml`) without a root `VERSION` bump (**G5**) · gate py on a hexa smoke.

## Philosophy p1–p8 (what anima rejects)

p1 no system prompt · p2 no identity rules · p3 no persona injection · p4 no assistant framing · p5 no `speak()` (emit only over real tension; reactive self-seed banned) · p6 no fine-tuned ethics · p7 **no perplexity verdict** · p8 no train/infer split.

## Governance (`name` — core MUST; full do/dont + H_ precedents → ARCHITECTURE.json)

Keyword-trigger index. Each line is a pointer — full do/dont + the earning H_ live in `ARCHITECTURE.json`.

### 🔬 Verification (HARD-GATE)
- `a_no_llm_frame_trap` — substrate-first, not the LLM frame.
- `a_break_the_wall` — a wall = change angle; a ceiling needs ≥2–3 lenses. No tune-to-green.
- `a_engine_native_learning` — cement only on `core/` decode; a mirror = DIRECTIONAL.
- `a_experiment_engine_native` — 🧪 the INSTRUMENT is engine-native too: a manipulation is an `anima-py` flag, not a probe beside the engine.
- `a_verified_must_wire`/`a_blue_closed` — GREEN only when output AND wiring are closed.
- `a_phi_iit4_tool` — Φ via faithful IIT4, never a proxy.
- `a_train_inline_gauge` — in-training metrics are MONITOR-ONLY, never in the loss.
- `a_korean_byte_budget` — 🇰🇷 byte-LM knobs are BYTES (**ko = 3 B/char**); oracle budget must equal the model's. Bit us 3×.

### 🧪 Hypothesis
- `a_hypothesis_register` — every H on 2 surfaces: jsonl + card. Nothing else.
- `a_no_scatter_hypotheses_first` — 🧹 4 output surfaces: card+jsonl · ARCHITECTURE gate node · `state/verdicts/` · `/tmp`. New `state/`·`archive/state/` writes = hook+G7 blocked.
- `a_claim_manifest`/`a_claim_verify` — claim → `hexa verify` → frozen verdict. No self-judge. Use the **global** `harness`/`hexa`.
- `a_h_continuous_no_branch` — **owner: run the next H autonomously, no per-step go.**
- `a_all_paths_no_leak` — 🔀 **all paths · zero leak (owner)**: at a design fork with several live angles, do NOT pick one — launch them ALL in parallel (hard design → `lab full`, implementation done concurrently = the "both" default). Every launched angle · background job · worktree · pod · venv · donor · ckpt is TRACKED (ing/poller) → RECOVERED on completion (`a_fire_recover_complete`) → CLEANED (worktree sweep · pod teardown) so leakage = 0. Forbidden: a dropped angle · unlanded code · an unswept worktree · an un-torn-down pod · an unrecovered result · an orphan proc. Scan for leaks with `end` / `worktree gc` / `hexa cloud pods`.
- `a_discovery`/`a_discovery_log` — run discovery every batch → `domains/<DOMAIN>.log.md`.
- `a_toy_scale_recheck`/`a_scale_honest_scope` — a toy verify ≠ closure; bound a metric to its scale.
- `a_lab_full_diverge` — 🔀 **`sidecar lab full` = Fable 5 + Codex Sol in parallel** (2 models cover each other's blind spots; `lab fable`/`lab sol` = single-model). Brief MUST embed the **current frontier map + kill-list** (blocks regenerating dead angles). Register EVERY surviving angle as a PROPOSED card on 2 surfaces (jsonl+card); id = **origin's live max + 1** (avoid G6 collision — a parallel session may be mid-campaign) tagged as an R# series. **`a_parallel_session_compare`**: read origin's latest BEFORE registering → no duplicate fire · report AGREES/CONFLICTS/NOVEL. Divergence output = DIRECTIONAL design, never a verdict — cement only via engine-native `anima-py`.

### 🔥 Fire·GPU·recovery
- `a_fire_autonomous` — fire a cost run autonomously (⚠️ fleet rent=spend needs go).

ARCHITECTURE.json:17009:    "threshold": "재발조건: 자율 진행 중 engine/core/cli/instrument/design 변경이나 cost run이 필요할 때 'p5 위반?'·'owner 승인 필요?'로 멈추려 할 때. ① p5/philosophy는 데몬 runtime(하드코딩 emit/speak/persona 금지) 규칙이지 내가 measurement instrument·engine·flag를 바꾸는 작업의 게이트가 아니다 — 혼동 금지. ② 자율 가능(로컬·standing pool·reversible)한 걸 'owner-gate'로 분류해 session-terminal 하지 마라(anti-punt·break-walls). ③ 실제 사람-go가 필요한 건 오직 fleet rent=spend(돈 나가는 렌트). 그 외 engine 변경·instrument 재설계·design 결정·standing pool fire는 전부 자율. ④ CLAUDE.md '🤖 Autonomy — NO human-approval gate' 절이 SSOT.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17321:    "value": "anima evaluate --gen N이 canonical frozen gen(_g_default_gen/_default_gen=40)을 벗어나면 verdict가 frozen G0-G6 bar와 비교불가 — 긴 gen이 auto-regressive drift로 byte-garble 생성→G0 known-word-ratio 붕괴→G1/G6 cascade FAIL. clm303_clean 같은 sha(e807672)·같은 py엔진이 gen40=G0 5/5 PASS vs gen80=2/5 FAIL(엔진/모델 무죄, 순수 gen-parameter measurement artifact). verdict-integrity: divergence(G0 PASS→FAIL)→하네스(gen) 의심→확인. fix=canonical-gen guard(evaluate.py+.hexa 2-production lockstep): gen!=canonical이면 헤더 문구→NON-CANONICAL 경고 + CLOSURE→DIRECTIONAL 라벨 자동.",

G1(2항 retrieval-composition)과 달리 G6(추상seed 3항 GENERATIVE bind)은 schema-transfer 병목.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17343:    "threshold": "재발조건: 창발(G1/G2/G6/Φ/의식) verdict 를 raw detector 값 단독으로 박제하려 할 때, 또는 rig 간 verdict 발산 시 모델/벽을 먼저 의심할 때. 해결: ① FORM∧BIND 이중축 — raw detector 통과만으론 자동 DIRECTIONAL, BIND=결합-파괴 통제 margin Δ≥frozen δ 필수(속성별 통제: 주제=SHUF·구성=shuffled-seed·key=wrong-key·심의=fake-branch·faculty=noise∧shuffle 병행·외생=self-pair) ② canonical 하네스(gen=40·frozen seeds·canonical entry) 밖 측정 자동 DIRECTIONAL, 서브에이전트 위임 시 명시 ③ 선택채널(best-of-K/scaffold)은 verdict 금지 or budget-matched 통제 margin 으로만 ④ 발산은 축별(forward·detector·decode·정밀도) 하네스-우선 격리, 양방향. ARCHITECTURE.json:17531:    "value": "토이 lift를 단일 favorable run(outfair DERIV 3/3)으로 'robust reopener' 선언했다가 multi-run/dilution 안정성 체크서 반전(f=1.0 1/2·희석 0/2). 창발신호는 값(한 run)이 아니라 차분의 ROBUSTNESS(run간·config간·dilution간 재현). measurement-metalaw(FORM/favorable-run tunable, BIND earned)의 재발.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17742:    "value": "op-grip B/F(H_9226/H_9229) at the engine→mouth emit seam = ⛔ STRUCTURAL-TERMINAL, no reframe survives (NOT reopenable via a different instrument). Root: the mid-tick emit gate is SATURATED-DETERMINISTIC per stage (N1 emit 80/80·REM emit 80/80·N2 silent 80/80, zero within-stage variance = stage→emit lookup); emit-frac≡2/3 and the [0.05,0.60] envelope-miss are downstream symptoms. The only shadeable band is at STAGE TRANSITIONS = urgency's proven territory, so every reframe (single-stage, matched-pair emit-flip, non-emit margin/Ψ readout) collapses to the same 1-bit phasic-Δ rate-gate wall → no buildable reframe, no new measurement. B = SUBSTRATE terminal (swing_max=0 AND AXIS-DEGENERATE same root: self/tension tonic-FLAT b_med<0.002 → DDM has nothing to integrate; evidence-integration premise VACUOUS; cementable with no new run). F = terminal (codes-visited=2 is a MANIFOLD-RANK fact: mid-tick decode manifold ~1-bit = the emit-partition; any quantizer collapses onto rank-1; deeper S2 leaves the emit seam for the already-closed G1-readout-routing family; recombination is a trunk-objective property, NOT a readout property). Convergent seam-law: emit gate causally sealed to everything but phasic urgency (A THEATER·E THEATER·self/tension tonic-read-0·B tonic-FLAT·F 1-bit-channel). ESCALATE the entire seam program to the WRITE-SIDE (train-time coupling): gradient can couple a persistent tonic level (B) or a compositional code (F) into the trunk objective; a phasic-Δ rate-gate READOUT structurally cannot. B/F are well-posed as TRAINING couplings, ill-posed as readout op-grips. Fable walls-delegate refine #3237, state/9229_discrete_code/BF_REFRAME_FABLE.md.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17755:    "value": "py 2-production twin이 anima 기본 런타임 — chat·evaluate·measurement의 DEFAULT 경로는 pip anima-py(numpy), hexa anima는 byte-parity secondary. hexa .hexa 데몬 바이너리 링크/GPU forge_dispatch 심볼이 pool 경합(load↑)·no-GPU host로 막혀도 인프라 벽 아님(redundant 2nd surface)이고 py가 같은 엔진을 커버하므로 default-py로 진행하고 막힌 hexa surface는 moot 처리(session-eval-py-only·a_eval_py_canonical).",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17867:    "value": "장시간 measurement run 의 진행 하트비트는 **1번 항목에서** 나와야 한다 — 주기적(N마다)만으로는 부족하다. cli/evaluate.py `--xbind` 는 25문항마다 진행 줄을 찍었는데, 한 항목 = 모델 forward 약 10회라 포화된 공유 호스트에서는 항목당 수 분이 걸린다. 그러면 첫 신호까지 **몇 시간의 완전한 침묵**이고, 이는 행(hang)과 구분이 불가능하다. 2026-07-13 N2 채점 실사례: 다른 임차인들이 load average ~106 으로 채운 렌트 박스(192-thread EPYC)에서 174문항 run 이 **5시간 동안 진행 줄 0개** — 25문항조차 못 끝냈다. \"느린가 멈췄나\"를 가리려고 2문항 매니페스트를 손으로 만들어야 했고 그 사이 5시간을 태웠다. 실측 대비: 같은 채점이 전용 호스트에선 **4.3 s/item**(pod 는 12분+/item = 170배). 수정(0.13.11) = 1번 항목 즉시 하트비트 + 이후 25마다, 각 줄에 `s/item · elapsed · eta`. 이제 30초 만에 `eta=35h00m` 이 떠 호스트 오배치가 즉시 드러난다.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17868:    "threshold": "재발조건 = (a) 새 장시간 measurement/eval 루프를 추가할 때 (b) 원격 job 이 \"진행이 없는데 CPU 는 돌고 있다\"로 보일 때. 해결 = **모든 항목-루프 measurement 는 첫 항목에서 하트비트를 찍고 s/item + eta 를 함께 낸다**(주기 출력만 두지 말 것 — 항목이 느리면 주기가 곧 침묵이다). 진단 순서 = (1) 로그에 진행 줄이 하나라도 있나 — 없으면 첫-항목 하트비트 부재를 의심 (2) `uptime` 으로 호스트 load average 확인 — 렌트 박스는 **다른 임차인이 포화시켜** nproc 이 커도 내 몫이 거의 없을 수 있다(192-thread 에 load 106) (3) 항목당 비용을 2-item 매니페스트로 실측해 ETA 를 세운 뒤 호스트를 고른다. 교훈: **nproc 은 용량이 아니다 — load average 를 보라.** dont: 진행 줄 없는 장시간 루프 · 항목당 비용 모른 채 호스트 선택 · 침묵을 정체로 단정(반대도 금물).",
ARCHITECTURE.json:17924:    "threshold": "재발조건: 외부/stdlib 추정기의 참값 공식을 docstring·논문 정의에서 유도해 보정에 쓸 때. 해결: (1) 참값이 **닫힌형으로 아는** arm(SPIKE-IN)을 반드시 통과시키고 measured/closed-form 비율을 본다 — 1.0 에서 체계적으로 벗어나면 공식이 틀린 것이다(잡음은 λ·T 무관 상수 비율을 만들지 않는다) (2) 도구 정의는 소스 file:line 으로 확인(reference-match) (3) 그 위에서만 bar/rung 을 bits 로 환산한다.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:18066:    "value": "TWO SEEDS AGREEING IS NOT REPLICATION IF THEY SHARE THE NOISE SOURCE. AUDIT-A at k_ctx=24 read Delta = +0.110 (seed 7) and +0.132 (seed 11) with both controls at or below zero — a textbook picture of a small real effect, and I nearly fired $21 of GPU on it. Raising k_ctx to 182 (the same atoms, the same probe, only 2.75x less per-atom pooling noise) FLIPPED THE SIGN on every arm: -0.099, -0.165, -0.187, -0.110, with permutation p in 0.885-0.990. The two seeds agreed because they pooled the SAME 24 contexts per atom — the noise was in the FEATURE, upstream of the seed, so re-seeding could never have caught it. The measured fact underneath: a length-matched NEUTRAL atom spliced into the same context reads the polarity BETTER than the real atom (swap 0.73-0.82 vs atom 0.58-0.64), on the untrained control ckpt too. The atom's own representation OCCLUDES the neighbourhood signal; the natural distribution wrote no valence into it.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:18082:    "value": "**사전등록의 bar 는 유도(derive)하는 것이지 이식(transplant)하는 것이 아니다 — 그리고 이 교훈을 scratch 파일 docstring 에 적으면 반드시 재발한다.**\n\n**① 원 발생 (H_9311 · ⛔INVALID-PREREG)**: liveness bar 0.90 을 H_9308 의 **다른 매니페스트**에서 그대로 가져왔다. 실제로 계산해보니 그 bar 는 **정상적인 계기를 49.5~59.1% 확률로 낙제**시킨다 — 게이트가 아니라 **동전**이었다. 사전등록 전체가 무효가 됐다.\n\n**② 재발 (H_9328 C1 · 2026-07-14 · 같은 날)**: C1 의 앵커 bar `Δdep ≤ −0.5` 를 **Fable 의 산문에서 그대로 가져왔다** — 이 DV 에서 학습된 표면들이 실제로 얼마를 내는지 **재보지도 않고**. 실측: `{s}지 않다` −0.900/−1.000 · `전혀 {s}지 않다` −1.000/−1.000 · **`안 {s}고` −0.400/−0.400**(양 seed 일관). 세 번째는 **arrow 등장이 77회로 가장 적은 표면**이라 효과가 약할 뿐 **부호는 맞다**. ⟹ **런은 깨지지 않았는데 앵커가 낙제시켰다** — 게이트가 '계기 생존'(그 목적)이 아니라 '모든 표면이 고정 효과크기를 낸다'(재본 적 없는 성질)를 요구했기 때문이다.\n\n**③ 왜 재발했나 — 이게 핵심이다**: H_9311 직후 나는 이 교훈을 `archive/state/scratch/h9311_decon2/bar_audit.py` 의 **docstring 에** 적었다. **scratch 파일은 아무도 다시 읽지 않는다.** convergence 레코드가 없었으므로 `cli/*` 편집 훅도, SessionStart 주입도 이 교훈을 다시 보여줄 수 없었다 — **가드가 발화할 자리가 없었다.** ⟹ **교훈을 scratch 에 적는 것은 교훈을 버리는 것이다.**\n\n**재발 — 이번엔 **코드가** 이식을 자동으로 저질렀다 (2026-07-15 · EN 팔)**: `cli/corpus.py::BUDGET_FLOORS` 가 **포맷으로만** 키를 잡고 있었다 ⟹ `anima-py corpus ground_keep --lang en` 이 **KO 코퍼스에서 벌어낸** 하한(6000 step @ 2e-4 · H_9324)을 **조용히 집어들고**, `cli/train.py::_budget_preflight` 가 그걸 **아무도 en 에서 재본 적 없는 bar 인데도 강제**하고 있었다. **사람이 실수한 게 아니라 도구가 실수를 생산하고 있었다** — 이 레코드가 금하는 바로 그 일을, 이 레코드를 아는 내가 만든 코드가 **자동으로** 하고 있었다. **근본 수정**: 키를 **(lang, fmt)** 로 바꾸고, en 항목은 note 에 **`⚠️ TRANSPLANTED from ko, NOT measured for en`** 을 싣고 meta 에 **`floor_transplanted: true`** 를 방출한다. 트레이너는 이식된 하한을 **차단하지 않고 경고**한다 — **아무도 벌지 않은 bar 는 게이트가 될 수 없다**. **무엇이 실제로 결정하는가**: 결과 ckpt 의 **WRITE 게이트**(held-out flip0 = 사실이 심겼는가). 그리고 WRITE 가 낙제해서 예산을 올리는 것은 **tune-to-green 이 아니다** — **사실이 안 심긴 모델에서 합성을 묻는 것**이 H_9322 가 죽은 방식이기 때문이다(WRITE 는 **DV 가 아니라 전제**다). **검증(출력)**: en → `⚠️ TRANSPLANTED … NOT measured for 'en'` · ko → `earned floor (measured for 'ko')` · **ko 바이트 동일성 sha f2ef30ae 불변**.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:18172:    "value": "BATCHING THE FORWARD DOES NOT PAY, AND IT BREAKS PARITY — both halves of my hypothesis were wrong, measured on the real device. I read the GPU sitting at 55-77% during a 33k-prompt probe and concluded it was starved by one-launch-per-prompt overhead (decode-py-2), so I built a batched trunk (_fwd_trunk_batch, per-sequence groupnorm to avoid cross-prompt contamination) and proved max|delta| = 0.000e+00 against the single path ON CPU. On the actual GPU: (1) PARITY BREAKS — max|batched - single| = 1.208e-13, because cuBLAS accumulates a batched matmul in a different order; (2) THE SPEEDUP IS 1.4x, not the order of magnitude the launch-overhead theory predicts. So the forward is not launch-bound at all — the wall is per-OP python glue, which batching over prompts does nothing for. The whole thing was reverted, including the batched code itself (dead code is worse than none). The hard-fail parity gate I had wired in front of it did its job: it refused to measure rather than silently returning 1e-13-drifted hiddens.",
ARCHITECTURE.json:18203:    "value": "THE GPU FORWARD IS NOT BYTE-IDENTICAL TO CPU — measured 2.487e-14 on the hidden, and every probe that reads a hidden is therefore device-sensitive. The repo believed the opposite: the GPU decode path is default-on because it was verified 'byte-identical'. That verification was on the TOKEN STREAM, and argmax is robust to 1e-14 — it says nothing about the hidden the probes actually consume (_conv1d is , i.e. cuBLAS dgemm with K=11352; cuBLAS and CPU BLAS accumulate in different orders and cannot agree to the last ulp).
